endorsements.quote: By making explicit the tacit features that pathologists rely on, and by mapping AI explainability outputs onto these named morphological features, both human and machine reasoning can be audited and aligned 48 , 49 .

unlisted_practices: Use a standardized checklist to quantify cellular and tissue-level morphological features when annotating histology for AI biomarker development.
Map AI explainability outputs onto named morphological features to verify that a model relies on biologically plausible features.
Establish high-confidence reference standards and engage panels of pathologists to capture tacit morphological knowledge for phenotypic-genomic correlations.
Generate reproducible, standardized annotated datasets in which candidate morphology-genomic associations can be tested prospectively.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article arguing for deliberate morphology and explainability to foster trust and responsible deployment of AI biomarkers in oncology.
